refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: y = chirp(t) y = chirp(t, f0) y = chirp(t, f0, t1) y = chirp(t, f0, t1, f1) y = chirp(t, f0, t1, f1, form) y = chirp(t, f0, t1, f1, form, phase)

listitem.para: Vector. Times to evaluate the chirp signal.
Real scalar. Frequency at t=0. Default is 0 Hz.
Real scalar. Intermediate time. Default is 1 second.
Real scalar. Frequency at t1. Default is 100 Hz.
String. Form of the chirp signal. Can be "linear", "quadratic", or "logarithmic". Default is "linear".
Real scalar. Phase shift at t=0 in degrees. Default is 0.
Vector. Chirp signal values corresponding to `t`.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function generates a chirp signal, which is a frequency-swept cosine wave. The signal can be linear, quadratic, or logarithmic based on the `form` parameter.
